scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy apps/hub/dist --project-name=web-playables --branch=main
scripts.historia:check: pnpm --filter open-historia typecheck && pnpm --filter open-historia lint && pnpm --filter open-historia check && pnpm --filter open-historia test && pnpm --filter open-historia cf:build
scripts.historia:e2e: pnpm --filter open-historia exec playwright test e2e/campaign.spec.ts e2e/campaign-layout.spec.ts --project=desktop --project=mobile
